responsibility: Drawing conventions for black and white vector sheets from a Rhino 9 model: a line hierarchy, line styles, hatch by material, labels and leaders, detail tags, a title block, the sheet layout, a tamper-proof request record and a parsed PDF check.
inputs: The open Rhino 9 document reached through the Rhino AI panel's Rhino tools, the user's request and the output folder they name. Load project context only when the task needs project records.

modes.when: Only for a requested PDF of a layout; the file is read back by the PDF check. Also this skill's lessons, appended in the plugin data folder the startup line names.
